chapter: Tuba, brass bands and the road
title: Playing brass bands around New Orleans
summary: He played street parades with the Tuxedo, George Williams and many unnamed pick-up brass bands.

blocks.x: And uh, then I started out with this making street parades and I had more work than I could handle. Which bands did you play with? I played with all of the bands around here. That's uh, I played with the Tuxedo. That's John Kazmi. And uh, George William. He had a good brass band at the time. Oh man, there's so many old brass bands at the time. Some bands didn't have no name.

That's right, I remember some of the bands. That's right, I remember some of the bands that get up the group. Yeah. I remember some times you'd be with the people like uh, Kid Howard, Matthew Williams, and they organized bands. Yeah, that's right. And they organized bands. Yeah. And George Lewis.
